newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP June copper concs output falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP June copper concs output falls.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said its total copper concentrates output fell nine percent to 50,200 tonnes in June from 55,200 tonnes a year earlier.

But total copper cathode and anode production rose five percent to 36,400 tonnes in June from 34,700 tonnes a year earlier, BHP said in its production report for June, the first month of its financial year ending May 31.
BHP said copper in concentrate production in Chile was higher due to higher recoveries, higher feed tonnes and improved filter performance.
Production of copper in concentrate in Papua New Guinea was lower due to unseasonably dry weather that resulted in a curtailment of mining and milling, it said.
Power generation and the movement of supplies was also hit by the dry weather which cut water levels in the Fly River, BHP said.
Production of cathodes in the United States was steady although higher production of anodes reflected higher sales demand.

Lower shipments of copper in concentrates from Chile were due to a revised shipping schedule while lower shipments from PNG were due to the low water in the Fly River, resulting in a revised shipping schedule.
BHP copper production ('000 tonnes unless otherwise stated)
NOTE: June is the first month of BHP's financial year.
